about: Fixed prompt set for the UNTERGRUND vs Suno blind A/B (docs/suno-benchmark.md). `styles` lists the UNTERGRUND genres that genuinely fit, best first (matched against STYLES ids and names); a prompt with no match yet is reported as pending, not rendered as a stand-in genre. `suno` is what to paste into Suno's Custom mode. Every song renders at `seed`: no cherry-picking on either side.
